posts.body_html: some updates on the heritage of this clone.  I spoke with Phil, and he informed me it either originally came from Santa Rosa/okaloosa county area, or from west of Liberty Co, FL.  My suspicion, based on the shape and color of the plant, is that it's more likely to have come from the santa rosa/okaloosa county area. There's quite a few atropurpureas over there, and they look somewhat similar to this plant.  the Gulf county and Bay County red tubes, on the other hand, have a completely different look to them.  However, you never know...
